purpose: Coach tactical decisions with event evidence, not a single opaque skill score
scope: Three downloaded user matches plus one separately labelled upstream telemetry sample

metrics.name: Macro maintenance under pressure
metrics.definition: Eligible TC empty seconds per TC-minute during confirmed combat versus quiet windows, matched by age and TC count
metrics.caveat: Shows performance change, not proof that attention caused it

metrics.name: Multiple-front handling
metrics.definition: Response coverage and response delay for spatially separated simultaneous threats; report losses and macro maintenance alongside
metrics.caveat: Threat grouping and relevant response require validation; simultaneous click locations are not fronts

metrics.name: Defensive response latency
metrics.definition: First relevant command after an eligible new visible threat or first damage; separate the two triggers
metrics.caveat: Not human perception time. Exclude already responding units and report unanswered threats as censored outcomes, not zero. Report median/p90 and success rate

metrics.name: Fight commitment and disengagement
metrics.definition: Local HP-adjusted army composition, reinforcements and defensive buildings at first commitment; time to retreat as known odds worsen
metrics.caveat: Evaluate information available at the time. Counter matchups, terrain, range, formation and objectives matter; global army count is not local strength

metrics.name: Combat efficiency
metrics.definition: Attributed enemy value destroyed versus own value lost per local engagement, plus damage participation, target switching, overkill and reinforcement arrival
metrics.caveat: Raw trade and a model-adjusted expectation must be separate; assists and buildings need explicit attribution; do not reward farming cheap damage

metrics.name: Early military contribution
metrics.definition: First non-scout military arrival in contested/enemy territory, first combat contribution, and contribution during team fights
metrics.caveat: Economic/support roles can contribute without early damage; do not rank players by first attack alone

metrics.name: Map presence and control
metrics.definition: Per-minute occupied military grid cells, cell-seconds, contested presence, resource/objective access and coverage over time
metrics.caveat: Presence, exploration, influence and sustained control are different metrics. Report scout coverage separately; condition early timing on map and strategy

metrics.name: Upgrade opportunity and payback
metrics.definition: Request and completion timing, eligible affordable windows, affected army/workers and estimated payoff
metrics.caveat: Nominal affordability alone does not establish a mistake; walking, hunted meat and civ modifiers affect economic payoff

metrics.name: Enemy villagers killed by this player
metrics.definition: Confirmed enemy villager death matched to the hostile lethal attacker owned by the player; separate assists and unattributed deaths
outputs: own raiding force value lost per kill
metrics.caveat: Never substitute own villagers lost, economy kills including non-villagers, or enemy losses without attribution

next_validation: Record one user replay with explicit desktop permission, validate event identity/time alignment against command stream and summary, then calculate tactical metrics. No desktop recording has been run.
